info.title: mpia
info.description:
Executable REST-style contract for the local mpia macOS data CLI. Invoke a path with `mpia METHOD "/path"`; this document does not describe a network HTTP server. Parameters are passed as one strict inline JSON object through `--params`; structured request bodies use `--body`.

HTTP methods are a semantic mapping:
| HTTP method | CLI semantics |
| --- | --- |
| `OPTIONS` | Permission, discovery, or verification |
| `HEAD` | Scalar metadata |
| `GET` | Read |
| `POST` | Create, execute, or export |
| `PUT` | Full replacement |
| `PATCH` | Partial edit |
| `DELETE` | Delete |
